scope: First-version unposted draft. No contacts, purchases, funding, signatures or transactions.

jobs.title: Fresh-state two-hop conservation verification
inputs: Fresh chain ID/block/hash/time; actual pool/provider/code fingerprints
Backing/stake/credit snapshots and consented graph inputs
acceptance: Pin all readings to one block or reject inconsistent snapshots
Check conservation, double counting, cycles, issuer/stake allocation and meaningful negative fixtures
Provide command, input hashes, output, definitions and freshness limit; distinguish current one-hop deployment from proposed transitive certificates
jobs.why_needed: Independent checks of live state and proposed transitive-capacity fixtures support team review; proposed multi-hop behavior is not already deployed.
jobs.employer: project treasury proposed; no accepted paid contract or reserved funds

payment_provenance.asset: USDC denomination only; chain/test-versus-real to be selected explicitly
payment_provenance.payer_source: No actual committed payer budget. Any future team grant must be marked internal employer spending, never outside customer revenue.
payment_provenance.same_controller_warning: Task assigned to a subagent does not create independent economic demand.

jobs.cash_input_status: No mandatory paid cash input identified. Existing scripts/artifacts and presently supplied read/compute channels allow offline or read-only work.
jobs.economic_caveat: Zero incremental priced cash in fixture is not zero total labor/compute/opportunity cost; those costs remain unquoted. Hypothetical positive margin does not establish profitability.
jobs.prepayment_comparison: If a genuinely necessary paid input is later verified, compare buyer prepayment/direct input payment, available cash and sponsor supply before any loan.

admission_result.exit_assumption: All positive net retained; paying humans reduces retained capital. No double counting human payout and reinvestment.
admission_result.human_fee_basis: Quoted hypothetical fees; no real deductions. Negative predicted surplus means no viable route
admission_result.human_eligibility: UNVERIFIED: no actual identity/legal/ramp/withdrawal access or quotes
admission_result.human_payout_basis: Earned resource-adjusted net only; gift excluded and ringfenced, not human income

jobs.title: Source/test reproduction with adversarial failures
inputs: Immutable source/test commits and public dependency hashes
Existing available local or sponsor-provided runtime
Named regression/fixture cases including CI30 and credit conservation
acceptance: Record build/tool versions, commands, source hashes and complete exit results
Reproduce intended passing and adversarial failing behavior; do not hide historical deployed defect
Distinguish original source, candidate patch, local run/fork and actual deployment; no signing
jobs.why_needed: A second implementation/run can find mistakes in mechanism and fix review; no claim of independent controller from spawning another same-team agent.

USDC transfer logs, loans, shares, backing, fees and source-restoration obligations

Compare before/after token accounting, full repayments, lender exits and external claims
Record missing receipts as unknown; preserve zero original live communities and existing source claim unless new proof establishes otherwise

funding_ringfence: Existing original15-USDC recoverable simulation seed, staged/source funds and commitments are not employer revenue or this board budget. No intentional default or purchase from that seed.
global_admission_gates: Actual named employer, accepted deliverable and separately committed payment budget
Mandatory paid input with invoice and necessity not substituted by free/team-supplied resource
Positive conservative earnings after measured work/compute/gas/fees/finance and failure costs
Necessary cash gap after cash/prepayment/direct sponsorship; no round-number5USDC loan absent demonstrated gap
Actual secured versus grant-backed allocation checked; no collateral or liquidity double count
Permissionless deployed CI30 fix and reviewed migration prerequisites before mainnet exposure; testnet paymaster capability not assumed
Separate task evidence from economic market qualification and human spendability
five_usdc_proposal: Proposed no-ETH/paymaster5-USDC rehearsal is a route demonstration, not an economically admitted loan for these current free/read-only jobs. Prove a necessary funded input first or label deliberately subsidized execution test.
